about: Studio Engine element catalog: the vocabulary of spec.json, written for any model. Times are BEATS from the scene start (120 BPM: 1 beat = 0.5 s). x/y are 0..1 of the frame; sizes are px at a 1080 short side. Colours are brand roles (primary, accent, glow, ice, warm, muted, paper, ink = the scene background, text; accentHi = the bright end of the accent pill) or #RRGGBB. Source of truth: lib/modules.js; lint: lib/gates.mjs.

fields.title: string
fields.bpm: number, default 120 (sets the clock; beats → seconds)
fields.duration: optional seconds; must equal sum(scene.beats) × 60 / bpm
fields.music: { progression: [chords], final: chord, hook: 'pop332' } — original score from lib/sound.mjs
fields.audio: { music: 'file.mp3', voice: 'vo.wav', musicRights, licenseScope, voiceRights, musicOffset } — optional supplied audio; tempo and word timings are extracted
fields.assets: [{ name, kind: 'image', prompt, refs, rights }] — files listed once; missing ones are written to assets-todo.json
fields.background: room (default glass room) | any BG key
fields.mode: showreel | product | launch-story | explainer — sets the edit pace the critic checks (showreel: new composition every 1–2.5 s, product 1.4–3.5 s)
fields.creative: free object copied into the production plan (direction, palette, reasons; viewer, problem, endState, hero, payoff, cta; decisions: one-line reason for each brief line the agent decided)
fields.facts: films/<film>/facts.json (not in the spec): { claims: [{ id, text, source: URL, sentence: exact source sentence }], copy: [brand-approved lines] }; any text element (or stack/slab line, wipes/cards item) carries "fact": "<claim id>"
fields.reel / youtube: any object (spec, scene or element) may carry { reel: {...} } or { youtube: {...} } overrides for that format

fields.id: unique string; gate messages name it
fields.music: intro | drop | chorus | hosts | verse | build | drop2 | finale | breath
fields.drop: true = musical drop on the scene start
fields.world: { speed: 1, tint: 0, bright: 1 } — the travelling room
fields.hold: true = an intentional still read at the end (the motion gate allows it)
fields.craft: free object merged into the production plan (scale, camera, focal, transition, layers…)

words.purpose: one kinetic line (Arabic or Latin, never both)

optional.on: colour the text sits on (contrast gate)
optional.sayAt: word in the voice-over that times it

stack.purpose: several lines with automatic vertical rhythm (no overlaps)

optional.lines[]: { text, size, weight, color, at, style, accent }

extrude.purpose: 3D extruded word that flies out of the camera, spins and settles; optional implosion

lockup.purpose: A × B 3D title with orbiting camera and floor reflection

slice.purpose: word cut in two by a slab

cards.purpose: before/after cards that turn one by one

optional.items[]: { title, titleAr, old, oldAr, new, newAr, oldIcons: [icon], newIcons: [icon] }

ring.purpose: 3D cylinder of cards around a glowing core, optional push-through

pill.purpose: call-to-action pill; parts keep Arabic and Latin apart

wipes.purpose: full-frame colour wipes, each with a big word and optional icon

optional.items[]: { at, bg, fg, text, size, icon, stripe }

hosts.purpose: people names (each person gets a beat)

shape.purpose: box / pill / circle that MORPHS through keyed states and can carry the eye into the next scene

optional.morph[]: { at, dur: 1, w, h, r, x, y, color, rot } — unspecified keys inherit
optional.morphTo: id of a shape in the next scene

path.purpose: SVG path morph between icons or path strings

optional.paths[]: icon name or SVG d in a 0..100 box

optional.name: doc mag stack check pen grid bars clip radar clock gear spark board chat people live cases tmpl hands qa gift mega star bolt heart rocket globe

image.purpose: an asset with depth drift (generated once or supplied)

ribbon.purpose: analytic depth-sorted 3D ribbon surface (twist, fold, material)

cursor.purpose: beat-timed pointer path with a click (cause for a change)

rules: Never mix Arabic and Latin words in one line: use two elements or pill.parts.
≥ 1.8 s per line; ~17 characters per second of visibility.
Text contrast ≥ 3:1 against the scene background (set `on` when text sits on a shape).
Every scene needs at least one element; `at` must be inside the scene.
Keep text inside the format's safe box; the stills stage names the scene that breaks it.
Logos whole (pop or blur-resolve), never assembled from pieces.
Only the client's words, claims and numbers.
